collection.description: An elder gives an apprentice a well-used crafting tool.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, gives an apprentice a well-used crafting tool. The surprise makes an otherwise ordinary afternoon memorable.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, gives an apprentice a well-used crafting tool. Nobody mentions the crooked workmanship, except affectionately.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, gives an apprentice a well-used crafting tool. The recipient seems touched and struggles to find words.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), an elder, gives an apprentice a well-used crafting tool. (Name1) had worried the gift was too simple.
